newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa firms step up offshore investment -report.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa firms step up offshore investment -report.

text.p: South African firms are stepping up their offshore investments with more 33 billion rand spent on major acquisitions over the last three years, BusinessMap consultancy said on Thursday.

If plans, bids and intentions are added to this total, then South Africa's offshore investment programme could be more than 65 billion rand, it added. These prospective deals would come off over the next two to five years.
The mining houses have been by far the largest players in offshore investment with acquisitions and exploration investment of at least 15 billion rand, much of it in Africa.
Outside of mining, the major acquisitions have been in the industrialised countries, notably Germany, Britain and the U.S.
BusinessMap said earlier this week that foreign direct investment into South Africa -- the flip-side of the coin -- had totalled over 30 billion rand since the first all-race elections in 1994.
